description: This line plot illustrates the perplexity of four different large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—as a function of the parameter M, which ranges from 3 to 8 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis represents perplexity, scaled linearly from 20.0 to 40.0. The plot displays three distinct lines: a green line with circular markers for LLaMA1-7B, an orange line with star markers for LLaMA1-13B, and a blue line with triangle markers for Vicuna-7B. The LLaMA1-7B line starts at a perplexity of approximately 29.0 when M=3, dips to around 26.0 at M=4, remains relatively flat near 26.0 until M=6, then rises to about 35.0 at M=8. The LLaMA1-13B line begins at approximately 20.0 when M=3, decreases slightly to around 19.0 at M=4, and then remains nearly constant until M=7 before rising to about 20.5 at M=8. The Vicuna-7B line starts at approximately 40.0 when M=3, decreases slightly to about 37.0 at M=4, remains relatively flat near 37.0 until M=7, then rises to about 40.0 at M=8.
